subtitle: A mild chicken curry with coconut, cream, rice and naan, suited to diners who prefer sweetness to chilli heat.
quickAnswer: Wetherspoons Chicken Korma costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes with white rice and naan bread. The sauce combines coconut, cream and delicate spices for a sweet, very mild curry. Prices vary by pub, and Thursday [Curry Club](/curry-club) pricing is worth checking before you order.

components.name: Chicken
components.note: Tender pieces of chicken give the curry its main substance, surrounded by the rich, creamy sauce.

components.name: Creamy coconut sauce
components.note: Coconut, cream and delicate fragrant spices create a velvety sauce with sweetness, nuttiness and very little heat.

components.name: White rice

components.name: Naan bread

taste:
This korma is sweet, creamy and exceptionally mild, with delicate fragrant spices rather than harsh heat. Coconut and cream give the sauce a rich, velvety texture, while its nutty flavour sits alongside the sweetness. Tender chicken pieces make this a soft-textured curry, with the sauce doing most of the work in each mouthful. It suits a preference for gentle aromatics rather than a pronounced chilli kick.

The dish is served piping hot with fluffy white rice and warm, soft naan bread. Rice gives you a base for the sauce; the naan offers a different texture alongside it. Expect a comforting, creamy meal whose defining qualities are sweetness and mildness.

Compare it with Chicken Tikka Masala or Beef Madras when choosing from the same section, but favour the korma if its sweet, creamy profile appeals. Thursday Curry Club pricing may affect the value at participating pubs. Many mains also have an eligible drink option, so check the local deal before ordering separately.
